mechanics.claim: The claw deals magic damage to enemies it passes through, potentially hitting multiple targets as it travels.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through

mechanics.claim: Both the initial cast and the recast (blink) count as ability activations, triggering on-cast effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: The claw missile decelerates over time from 1200 to 640 speed, which can affect how quickly and how many times it hits targets over the fight window.
The ability's cooldown begins when the ability is cast, not after the recast/blink resolves.
The recast cannot occur while Lissandra is grounded or rooted.
mechanics.quote: ''Glacial Path'' cannot be recast while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}.
